decisions.reason: As a consumer-health line extension sold through existing pharmacy channels, it fits the firm's stated portfolio-broadening strategy and is relatively easy to support.
This skin-and-hair supplement sits close to the firm's established consumer-health offer and should be retained unless sales have been clearly weak.
A joint-health supplement complements the firm's pharmacy-focused OTC portfolio and is strategically aligned with gradual range expansion.
Although niche, this immune supplement extends the existing dietary-supplement series and can be kept as a differentiated pharmacy product.

Because this blood-pressure generic was more distant from the established offer and already faced a quality-related problem, management would be relatively likely to discontinue it and redeploy resources.
The OTC migraine triptan is newer and somewhat outside the core range, but it still fits the firm's pharmacy and consumer-health channels well enough to continue for now.
